name: range_proof_64bit
description: Canonical 64-bit range proof: prove a private value x in [0, 2^64) that opens a public Poseidon commitment. Designed to be reused as a building block

x.description: Value being range-checked (must fit in 64 bits)

salt.description: Random salt that hides x in the public commitment

commitment.description: Poseidon(x, salt) anchored on-chain or in a registry
